text:
maria: did a quick audit sweep across api-gateway, auth, console, billing, runtime. hit a few gaps where events emitted from console/backend lack customer context and request ids. posting notes and owners.

kyle: can you paste an example log where fields are missing?

maria: yes  sample from prod shard:
```
[2026-02-11T22:07:18Z] svc=api-gateway event=role_change actor=svc-internal target=user:U789 payload={\"change\":\"grant_role\",\"role\":\"org_admin\"}
// missing customer_id, missing request_id
```

devon: that matches what we saw: console-originated admin actions don't propagate org_id through the console proxy. console backend emits role_change but doesn't attach tenant context for cross-tenant admins.

anika: propose schema v2.2 fields: schema_version, event_id, timestamp, actor_id, target_id, action, resource_type, customer_id, request_id, auth_method, outcome, metadata. keep metadata free-form for non-PII.

kyle: ok. request: event_id must be uuidv4, include schema_version top-level. billing team also needs KMS envelope headers for any event with payment or PII fields.

maria: security question: do we require a migration/compatibility plan for older events in kafka? downstream consumers will break if we flip validation immediately.

audit-bot: rolled out audit-schema-checker v2.2 to staging. New rule requires top-level schema_version. Nonconformant messages -> audit-errors topic.

devon: plan suggestion:
- console: attach customer_id (org_id) + request_id for outgoing audit events. owner: @devon. target: 2026-02-17
- api-gateway: pass through X-Schema-Version header and ensure request_id propagation. owner: @kyle. target: 2026-02-17
- ingest/runtime: add compatibility transformer for 30d to map legacy messages (lookup customer via auth table). owner: runtime team. target: 2026-02-24
- billing: wrap billing_line_item with kms_metadata, invoice_id, masked_payment_method fields. owner: billing-eng. target: 2026-02-24
- security: run replay tests + sample validation. owner: @anika. target: 2026-02-24

kyle: for billing_line_item specifically, ensure invoice_id and masked_payment_method are separate fields (invoice_id and payment_method_last4). do NOT put last4 inside free-form message.

maria: adding a tiny validator curl example for staging ingest endpoint:
```
curl -X POST https://staging-ingest.redwood.ai/audit -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"schema_version":"2.2","event_id":"b3f1c7d4-8a2e-4a5b-9d2a-1a2b3c4d5e6f","timestamp":"2026-02-11T22:07:18Z","action":"charge","customer_id":"org_42","invoice_id":"inv_2026_01","payment_method_last4":"4242","outcome":"success"}'
```

devon: runtime-oncall please watch the ingestion topic during deploy. we'll replay legacy messages at <=50rps and monitor backpressure.

runtime-oncall: acknowledged. will set alert if audit-errors topic rate > 100/min or ingest-lag > 30s. will pause replays if error spike.

anika: I'll create the GH issue with the checklist and owners. also drafting a short customer-facing audit schema doc for compliance teams (SOC2 / customer evidence) to show required fields and retention semantics.

maria: one more: runtime should implement a small enrichment fallback that adds customer_id when missing by referencing auth/uid->org mapping. keep a trace flag so we can audit fallback lookups.

kyle: and add schema_version to kafka message headers too so consumers can short-circuit parsing.

maria: done. opening triage issue and assigning people now. ping here if you hit blockers :thumbsup:
